messages:
Ana (Mktg): Quick sync 60 we need final social cadence for tomorrow's webinar 'Serving at Scale'. Platform focus: X thread + LinkedIn post + two registrant follow-ups. Who can lock assets and schedule windows today? https://redwood.example/webinar/serving-at-scale
Liam (Design): I can do hero banner, 20s clip, and one carousel slide. What copy variants do you want? Square + 16:9 ok?
Ana (Mktg): Yup square + 16:9. Need two headline variants for A/B and a short overlay CTA frame. Also export with transparent CTA layer if possible.
Dara (Growth): Timing rec: X announce 9:30am PT, X thread 9:35am, LinkedIn 10:00am, reminder X 1:30pm PT. Ops can queue. Also need UTM parameters.
Omar (Analytics): Use utm_source=social&utm_medium=xl&utm_campaign=serving_at_scale_2026&utm_content={variant}
Bea (Content): Caption 1: "Serving at Scale: real-world LLM serving patterns for predictable latency. Free webinar 1 Register 7 https://redwood.example/webinar/serving-at-scale"
Bea (Content): Caption 2: "Cut LLM serving cost without sacrificing latency 1 Join our practicioners on Wed. Register: https://redwood.example/webinar/serving-at-scale"
Ana (Mktg): Great. Liam, include both headline overlays. Dara, thread skeleton: 5 posts (hook, stat, quick tech nugget, customer line, CTA). Bea will draft microcopy.
Bea (Content): Thread draft: 1) Hook: "Serving speed is a product metric." 2) Stat: "Customers saw 55% fewer p99 timeouts" 3) Note: "KV-prefix caching + batching cuts tokens" 4) Quote: "Thanks to Redwood, our checkout latency hit SLA" 5) CTA + link. I'll add variants.
Liam (Design): Will upload assets to Figma: https://figma.com/file/serve123/serving-assets. ETA by 3:30pm PT. Exports: PNGs + MP4.
Riley (Sales): For demo-intent leads, route to SDR queue with 'webinar-demo' flag. Need mapping doc and Slack alert.
Ana (Mktg): Add 'request-demo' checkbox on form. Riley, who owns the mapping?
Riley (Sales): I'll own routing. Send me the sheet template. Immediate Slack ping + create SFDC lead. Daily digest at 5pm PT too.
Omar (Analytics): I'll add event webinar_signup with property demo_request=true/false and publish mapping before 4pm PT.
Dara (Growth): Ops 6 ScheduleBot, please queue: X announce 9:30 PT, thread 9:35 PT, LinkedIn 10:00 PT, reminder 1:30 PT. Use Caption1 default, use Caption2 for thread CTA variant. Add UTM.
SchedBot: Scheduled: campaign#10021. Announcement queued for 1765457400 (9:30am PT). Thread job at 1765457600. Posting account: @redwoodinc.
Liam (Design): Uploaded final exports, added overlay layers for both headlines. Need final CTA text.
Ana (Mktg): CTA: "Save your seat 1 Limited spots". Use white 42px on dark overlay, button color #ff5a00.
Riley (Sales): Confirmed Slack alert setup and SFDC mapping. Will tag region owners on create.
Bea (Content): Suggest pinning a LinkedIn follow-up 24h after with recording + TL;DR bullets. That helps capture registrants who didn't attend.
Dara (Growth): Agreed. I'll set a follow-up job for 24h post-webinar once recording is available and set up retargeting pool.
Omar (Analytics): Also add watch_recording and replay_utm params for the replay link.
Liam (Design): All files exported and attached in Figma exports page. Sending final assets here.
Ana (Mktg): Perfect. One last ops check: Riley, immediate ping + daily digest works?
Riley (Sales): Immediate ping + daily digest at 5pm PT. Prioritize demo_request=true leads.
Ana (Mktg): Locking plan. If no objections we'll proceed. :thumbsup:
Bea (Content): Pasted full thread copy + micro-variations into campaign doc.
Dara (Growth): Campaign calendar updated and scheduling confirmed.
Omar (Analytics): Tracking mapping published.
SchedBot: campaign#10021 executed for announcement (1765457400). Thread posted job created for 1765457600.
Ana (Mktg): Big thanks team 6 special shout to @Liam for fast turn. We'll review engagement metrics tomorrow AM and feed back into the benchmark narrative. :rocket:
